verdict.rationale: Slack explicitly advertises an App Directory with 2,600+ prebuilt apps (Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, ChatGPT, etc.) and a help doc specifically for admins on how to add apps to a workspace. This directly matches the team-admin persona and app-platform theme. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the admin install/approval workflow beyond the docs, and no detail on admin-specific approval controls for directory apps (only MCP client approval is mentioned).
